few.summary: A deploy in five stages, played from the bar: the current stage lit, the ones done washed.

stages.name: Checkout
stages.note: Clone the commit that was pushed.

stages.name: Install
stages.note: Restore the dependency cache, install what changed.

stages.name: Build
stages.note: Bundle the app and the playground.

stages.name: Deploy
stages.note: Start a preview and route its domain.
